# libarchive / libarchive_write_fuzzer

libarchive's own fuzz target `libarchive_write_fuzzer` ([source](source/libarchive_write_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libarchive (libarchive/libarchive at 3670ecf7).

Writes up to 10 fuzz entries (file/dir/symlink, ids, mtime, <= 1 KiB data) in one of 8 formats (pax_restricted, gnutar, ustar, cpio newc, zip, 7zip, xar, pax) through one of gzip/bzip2/xz/zstd/none into an in-memory vector. The produced archive is never read back or inspected; header/data return codes ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libarchive at commit 3670ecf7.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
